new_learnings.text: Today confirms h021 again: the MA-distance anti-chase rule is the main blocker, not lack of momentum. Many of the strongest names are valid stories but invalid entries.
new_learnings.mechanism: In a broad but not explosive tape, overextended leaders have poor reward-to-risk because support is too far below and a normal pullback can hit stops quickly.

new_learnings.text: A green tape is not enough by itself. Breadth is positive, but the strict 1.5:1 minimum gate is not met, so cash preservation remains the correct default despite many attractive charts.
new_learnings.mechanism: When breadth is only mildly positive, breakouts have less follow-through and the opportunity cost of waiting is lower than the downside from forcing entries.

new_learnings.text: Sector heat is concentrated in electronics and power-equipment branches, but most candidate names in those groups are already too far above MA10/MA20. The right response is to wait for support tests, not downgrade the themes.
new_learnings.mechanism: Theme strength and entry quality are separate variables; hot sectors create opportunity, while MA compression determines when the risk/reward becomes buyable.
